monthClosing.reloadNeeded: The report was saved, but the refreshed view could not be loaded. Refresh the month before another action.
monthClosing.title: Month closing
monthClosing.asClosed: Historical state as closed. Later payments and transfers do not change this version.
monthClosing.endBalanceCents: Observed balance on the final day
monthClosing.noOperations: Operation detail was not provided. Allocation changes do not establish income or spending.
monthClosing.separate: Closing saves a historical report. To check the card or move money, use Update budget separately.
monthClosing.pending: Historical facts changed. The accepted report remains unchanged until you review and confirm a new version.
monthClosing.unelected: Not included in the unpaid reserve
monthClosing.consent: I reviewed all report sections, the unknown values and the exact changes, and confirm this version.
monthClosing.memory: Drafts stay in memory only. Reload, crash or sign-in can lose the draft.
monthClosing.unsaved: The new reason or review has not been confirmed. Leave this draft? Already saved report versions remain saved.
monthClosing.error: The report could not be confirmed or read safely. Refresh the month and review again; your draft has been retained.
monthClosing.noChange: No new historical changes. The accepted version remains saved.
monthClosing.noChangePending: The comparison found no meaningful report changes; no new version was created. The server review flag remains pending. The accepted version is unchanged. Reload the confirmed state to check its current status.
monthClosing.saved: Report version saved. Current cash and earmarks were not changed.

completeness.END_DATE_OBSERVED: A real check exists on the final day; this does not establish complete bank activity.
completeness.INCOMPLETE: Final-day bank balance is unknown. The amounts shown are the last confirmed historical state.
completeness.NO_OBSERVATION: No bank observation exists through this month end. Bank balance, allocation and free amount are unknown.

monthClosing.unknownOutcome: The confirmation result is unknown. Check the original request or explicitly retry it with the same key. Do not create a new confirmation.
monthClosing.evidenceExplanation: Review every page of sources and evidence. Amounts can stay the same even when the historical basis changes.
monthClosing.initialReportExplanation: You are saving the first historical report for this month. Unknown amounts stay unknown. Closing does not debit or transfer money.
monthClosing.reviewSourcesEmpty: There is no additional historical evidence. The known data and unknown amounts shown above will be saved.
monthClosing.reviewSameAmounts: Amounts are unchanged. Review the dates, sources, ordering and historical evidence changes below.
monthClosing.initialSourcesExplanation: These are the historical sources for the first report. Review every page before confirming.
monthClosing.updatedRecord: Updated confirmed record; linked sources are shown in this group
monthClosing.confirmedRecord: Confirmed source of this historical report
monthClosing.reviewProgress: Read every page of significant confirmations; reviewed {read} of {total}
monthClosing.coverageFailed: The complete readable comparison could not be verified. Confirmation is unavailable. Reload and review again.
monthClosing.downloadEvidence: Download complete original evidence (internal values / euro cents)
monthClosing.noInferredFlows: A final-day check does not prove that all bank operations are known. Differences between card checks are not confirmed income or expenses.
monthClosing.noChangesVersion: No new historical changes. Version {n} is saved.
monthClosing.pendingVersion: Version {accepted} is saved. Historical changes were found. You can prepare version {next}.
monthClosing.updateOptional: Checking the card or moving money is a separate action and is not required to close this month.
monthClosing.currentAllocation: Current allocation from the latest card check
monthClosing.currentNotHistorical: This is the active distribution of confirmed money, not the historical result of the selected month. Opening this section changes nothing.
monthClosing.currentUnavailable: Current allocation is unavailable. The accepted historical report remains separate.
monthClosing.timeNotRecorded: Time of the check was not recorded

budgetUpdate.title: Update budget
budgetUpdate.description: Enter the checked card balance, allocate the full amount across months and review all changes before saving them together.
budgetUpdate.moneyHint: No thousands separators; for example 123.45. At most two decimal places.
budgetUpdate.reuse: Only redistribute already confirmed money without a new card check
budgetUpdate.memoryOnly: The draft stays only in this form's memory. Recovery after reload, a crash or a Google redirect is not promised.
budgetUpdate.name: Title
budgetUpdate.reason: Explanation (required for payment outside the card)

modeLabel.FRESH_START: Start fresh while retaining obligations and savings

budgetUpdate.fundingConsent: I confirm the full transfer of the listed obligation and savings funding
budgetUpdate.nonCarryConsent: I confirm clearing past active allocations while retaining their history
budgetUpdate.futureConsent: I confirm the listed changes to future months' money
budgetUpdate.unchangedFundingConsent: Only the money allocation changes; obligation and savings funding stays unchanged
budgetUpdate.vectorConsent: I have checked the complete allocation of the card balance across all months
budgetUpdate.bankConsent: I actually checked the card; the entered balance already includes the payments
budgetUpdate.unchangedConsent: I confirm the balance is current even when it matches the previous amount
budgetUpdate.paymentWarning: Payment releases its reserve and never automatically debits the card. An unchanged balance requires a separate confirmation that it is current.
budgetUpdate.safeDaily: Safe daily limit from confirmed data
budgetUpdate.oldData: The estimate uses an earlier actual card check.
budgetUpdate.reminder: Please check the card balance again.
budgetUpdate.nonPosting: Allocation changes and balance differences are not confirmed income or expenses. Reserves and savings do not debit the card.
budgetUpdate.savedReadFailed: Saving is confirmed, but the result could not be loaded yet.
budgetUpdate.unknown: The save outcome is still unknown. Check it or retry the original request with the same key.
budgetUpdate.reloadBase: Load current base and retain inputs for a new review
budgetUpdate.unsaved: There are unsaved changes. Leave and lose this draft?

errors.compound: The same item cannot be changed and have its funding transferred in one update. Your draft is retained; nothing is partially saved. First confirm the month transition without editing that item. Then make a separate, explicitly confirmed payment or savings change. Your draft is retained in memory; no automatic second save occurs.
errors.payment: Check the payment amount, actual balance and required confirmations. Payment outside the card requires a confirmed unchanged balance and an explanation.
errors.policy: Carrying several past source months together is not supported yet. Only you can choose another action.
errors.access: Access could not be verified. Sign in again and check the outcome before saving again.
errors.conflict: Confirmed data, ordering or the month has changed. Your input is retained: load the current base and review again.
errors.storage: The operation could not be completed. Your input is retained; retry the original request or read the outcome.
errors.input: Check amounts, dates, actions and confirmations. Monthly amounts must be nonnegative and sum exactly to the card balance.
errors.sameDay: Confirm that this new check follows the saved events on the same day. Your draft is retained.
errors.stale: Confirmed data changed after this form was loaded. Your draft is retained: load current data, review it and give the required consents again.
errors.ordering: The order of events changed or this position is not valid. Your draft is retained. Load current data and review the order.
errors.historical: The historical basis differs from the saved data. Your draft is retained; load current data and review the date and changes.

budgetUpdate.historicalSeparate: This current estimate is separate from the historical check above.
budgetUpdate.stateUnavailable: No confirmed balance at this historical basis
budgetUpdate.reportImpact: Historical reports are affected. Their saved versions remain unchanged until a separate correction is reviewed and confirmed.
budgetUpdate.chooseTransition: Earlier-month money or funding needs your explicit decision. Review the complete distribution and all retained obligations and savings.
budgetUpdate.sameMonthRoutine: Ordinary balance update. No month transition is required unless earlier funding remains unresolved.
budgetUpdate.sameDayHint: Confirmed events already exist on this date. This new check will follow them. Confirm this order separately.
